meta.title: CenterFlow — Run your education center in real time
meta.description: CenterFlow is a real-time management platform for education centers: attendance, homework, payments, groups and a gamified student app in one place.

hero.subtitle: Students, groups, attendance, homework, payments and your team — synced live between your staff app and a student app your learners actually enjoy opening.

apps.title: Built for both sides of the classroom.
apps.subtitle: Your staff run the center from one app. Your students live inside another — playful, gamified, and always in sync with what happens in class.

staff.desc: The command center for owners, admins and tutors — students, groups, schedules, payments and your whole team in one dashboard.
points: Add students, group them by section and assign tutors in minutes

features.title: One platform, every part of running a center.
features.subtitle: No add-ons to hunt down. Every plan starts with the whole toolkit — attendance, grading, payments, chat and more, live across both apps.

items.title: Real-time attendance
items.desc: Present / Late / Absent / Excused tracked per lesson, synced instantly to the student and parent view — no more false 0% attendance.

items.title: Homework & grading engine
items.desc: Discipline, homework and activity marks roll up into a fair, per-lesson leaderboard, awarded only when a lesson closes.

items.title: Lesson scheduling
items.desc: Lessons are materialized automatically, with per-day overrides for holidays, substitutions and one-off changes.

items.title: Groups & courses
items.desc: Group students by section, assign a tutor and a course, and manage capacity without spreadsheets.

items.title: Team & permissions
items.desc: Every section splits into See and Manage — give a tutor visibility without handing over control.

items.title: Payments & invoicing
items.desc: Invoices follow real module and lesson-count boundaries, with sequential type-prefixed IDs (INV-, PAY-, WD-).

items.title: Real-time chat
items.desc: Direct messages, group chat and lesson-scoped announcements, with real profile photos on both apps.

items.title: Materials library
items.desc: Hierarchical folders with search, so every group finds the right file without a scavenger hunt.

items.title: Certificates
items.desc: Design and issue certificate templates tied to your own courses and achievements.

items.title: Extra lessons
items.desc: Students request extra help, tutors accept or decline, with a clean main-teacher referral workflow.

items.title: Leaderboard & XP
items.desc: A fair, gamified ranking system that keeps students coming back — without turning grading into a popularity contest.

items.title: Device & security controls
items.desc: Kick or ban risky devices, VPN / geo risk scoring and bot protection on every sign-up.

staff.title: Running your center on CenterFlow
staff.subtitle: Everything an owner, admin or tutor needs — from creating the center to getting paid.

sections.title: 1. Create your center & sign in
sections.summary: Register your center as the owner and pick the language your team will see.
steps: Go to centerflow-app.comma.uz and choose “Create a center”.
Enter your center's name, your phone number, and set a password.
Confirm the code sent to your phone to verify your account.
Pick your center's default language — you can change it any time in Settings.
You're now signed in as the owner, with full Admin access.

sections.title: 2. Add students
sections.summary: Add students one by one, or invite them to self-register with a code.
steps: Open Students from the sidebar and click “Add student”.
Fill in their name, contact details, and (optionally) a parent's phone number.
Upload a photo, or leave the default avatar — students can add their own photo later.
Assign them to a group now, or leave it for later and group them in bulk.
Repeat, or generate an invite code so parents can register students themselves.

sections.title: 3. Invite your team
sections.summary: Bring in tutors and admins with a join code — no manual account creation.
steps: Open Team and click “Invite member”.
Choose their role: Admin, Tutor, or Support tutor.
Share the generated join code or link with them directly.
They register at centerflow-app.comma.uz and enter the code to join your center.
Fine-tune exactly what they can See and what they can Manage under each permission section.

sections.title: 4. Group students by section
sections.summary: Organize students into groups, tied to a course and a tutor.
steps: Open Courses and create a course if you haven't already (e.g. “IELTS Intermediate”).
Open Groups and click “Create group” — give it a name (e.g. “IELTS Int. — Tue/Thu”).
Assign the course, the tutor, and a room or time slot.
Add students to the group from the roster, or drag them in from Students.
Repeat for every section — a student can belong to more than one group.

sections.title: 5. Build the schedule
sections.summary: CenterFlow materializes lessons automatically from your group's weekly pattern.
steps: Open Schedule and set the weekly pattern for each group (days, time, room).
Lessons are generated automatically, several weeks ahead, and kept in sync.
Need a one-off change? Open Lessons and override a single day — holiday, substitution, or reschedule.
Every override is scoped to that day only; the regular weekly pattern resumes after.

sections.title: 6. Run a lesson: attendance & grading
sections.summary: Everything for a live lesson happens on one page.
steps: Open Lessons and select today's session.
Check in students as they arrive — attendance updates in real time on the student app.
Award discipline, homework and activity marks per student.
Post a lesson announcement or attach materials for the group.
Close the lesson when it ends — marks are only awarded to the leaderboard at close time, so it stays fair.

sections.title: 7. Share materials
sections.summary: Keep files organized in folders your team and students can actually search.
steps: Open Materials and create a folder structure that matches your courses.
Upload files — documents, images, or links to external resources.
Attach materials to a specific lesson so students see them in context.
Use search to find a file instantly instead of digging through folders.

sections.title: 8. Payments & invoicing
sections.summary: Invoices follow real lesson counts, not the calendar month.
steps: Open Payments to see the unified Transactions tab — every payment, invoice and withdrawal.
Invoices are generated automatically at real module / lesson-count boundaries, with a due date.
Record a payment against an invoice, or record an ad-hoc top-up.
Every transaction gets a sequential, type-prefixed ID (INV-, PAY-, TOPUP-, WD-) for clean bookkeeping.
Open Payroll to review what's owed to each tutor for the period.

sections.title: 9. Certificates
sections.summary: Design a certificate once, issue it to any student in seconds.
steps: Open Certificates and create a template — add your center's branding and a course name.
Issue it to a student directly from their profile, or from a completed course.
Students see and can download their certificates from their own profile.

student.title: Using CenterFlow as a student
student.subtitle: Everything you need to check your schedule, do homework, and see how you're doing.

sections.title: 1. Join your center
sections.summary: Your center's staff will give you a join code or add you directly.
steps: Go to student-app.comma.uz.
If you have a join code from your center, choose “Join with code” and enter it.
If a parent registered you already, sign in with the phone number they used.
Set your password after confirming the code sent to your phone.
Pick your avatar and language — English, Russian or Uzbek.

sections.title: 2. Your Home tab
sections.summary: Home shows what matters today, at a glance.
steps: See today's and upcoming lessons the moment your center schedules them.
Check your attendance rate — Present / Late / Absent / Excused, not guesswork.
See recent announcements from your tutors and your center.
Tap any lesson card to open its full details.

sections.title: 3. Lessons in the Learn tab
sections.summary: Every past and upcoming lesson, with topic, plan and materials.
steps: Open the Learn tab and select Lessons.
Tap a lesson to see its topic, plan, and any attached materials.
Past lessons show your attendance and the marks you were awarded.
Look for lesson-scoped announcements posted by your tutor.

sections.title: 4. Submitting homework
sections.summary: Submit your work and track discipline, homework and activity marks.
steps: Open Learn → Homework to see everything assigned to you.
Attach your answer — text, an image, or a file.
Submit before the lesson closes; marks are awarded once your tutor closes the lesson.
Check back to see your marks and how they affect your leaderboard position.

sections.title: 5. Requesting extra lessons
sections.summary: Need extra help? Request a session directly.
steps: Open Learn → Extra lessons.
Pick a tutor and a time, and send your request.
Your main teacher can refer you to a support tutor if that's a better fit.
You'll be notified the moment the tutor accepts or declines.

sections.title: 6. Chat & announcements
sections.summary: Message your tutors and your group directly.
steps: Open the Messages tab to see your conversations.
Message a tutor directly, or post in your group chat.
Center-wide announcements and lesson-specific posts show up automatically.

sections.title: 7. Profile, XP & the leaderboard
sections.summary: Track your progress and see how you rank.
steps: Open Profile to see your bio, achievements and any certificates you've earned.
Every discipline, homework and activity mark contributes fairly to your XP.
Open the leaderboard from Home to see your group and center-wide ranking.
Marks are only awarded once a lesson closes, so the ranking stays fair for everyone.
